description: List the jobs for one customer, 30 per page. Kickserv: GET /{account}/customers/{customer_number}/jobs.xml.

include.description: Related data to embed: customer, employees, job_charges, time_entries, notes, job_type, job_status, tax_entity, custom_field_assignments.

only.description: Comma-separated list of columns to return, e.g. `customer_number,name`. Kickserv recommends this: it makes responses much smaller and faster.

page.description: Page number (Kickserv returns 30 records per page). Omit for page 1.

name: kickserv_list_customer_jobs
title: List a customer's jobs
